title: Add a no-change guard that records the producer's reason
summary: When the producer ends with an empty change list, it must give a reason: what it tried and what blocked it. Athena sends that back once if the reason is missing, records it, and ends the job as a distinct "no change" outcome carrying the diagnosis. Today it fails with "the producer made no change" or the generic unmet-criteria send-back. The audience is the user reading the job outcome.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria require a new test, and require cargo test and clippy to pass.
The test checks a recorded no-change outcome containing the reason, not just that a field exists.
The check is the job's final state and reason, not the code path.
The empty-diff branch itself is changed, not only the message text.
The guard is enforced in the run loop and tested, not left as prompt text alone.
One focused change on the producer stage's empty-diff path.
Behavior criteria name the cargo commands the verifier runs.
All changes are in Rust, plus the prompt and changelog.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: 'No change' is a new OutcomeState variant (NoChange) in athena-data records, not a Failed outcome with different text.
The reason is a new field on ProducerOutput (e.g. no_change_reason), stored in the candidate's producer_report and in the outcome reason.

Where the change list is empty and the reason is missing or blank, the producer is sent back once asking for the reason, instead of the unmet-criteria list. If it is still missing, the job ends as no change saying no reason was given.
An empty change list for a retry seeded from a kept candidate keeps its current behavior, because that candidate already differs from the base.
The criteria-unmet send-back is skipped for an empty-diff run, since the no-change diagnosis replaces it.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new lifecycle test in crates/athena-cli/tests/lifecycle.rs uses a scripted producer that makes no edits and reports a no-change reason (what it tried and what blocked it). The finished job has state NoChange. The recorded outcome reason contains the producer's reason text. No verifier is invoked. Run: cargo test -p athena-cli --test lifecycle.

A test shows a no-edit producer that gives no reason is sent back once for the reason and not for the unmet-criteria list. If it still gives none, the job ends as no change and says no reason was given. Run: cargo test.

ProducerOutput and its schema gain a documented field for the no-change reason. The producer prompt (crates/athena-context/prompts/producer.md) tells the producer to fill it when it makes no change, with the examples of an unobtainable tool checksum and too many surfaces for one run.

The empty-diff branch in crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs ends the job with the new no-change outcome and the producer's reason, not Failed with the generic text. OutcomeState handles the new variant everywhere it is matched, including display and docs.

The existing tests that expected 'made no change' failures (lifecycle.rs, retry.rs, run_pin_tests.rs) are updated to the new outcome and pass. cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo fmt --check are all clean.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the guard, and any docs that list outcome states mention no change.

out_of_scope: Changing how a retry seeded from a kept candidate is handled.
Changes to the verifier stage or to the checks.
Changing the budgets or timeouts of the producer.
departures: Adding an OutcomeState variant touches many match sites and existing tests, so cost and time sit slightly above the reference.
